pages.title: Spacetime Anchor Pylon
pages.text: A pylon that pins a patch of spacetime in place, built around a spacetime anchor core and a chronosteel coil. The ground around it feels unusually solid, as if gravity had made its mind up. Compasses near it point steady.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Large machines warped the ground they stood on. I built a pylon around an anchor core with a chronosteel coil and hyperframe casing, and the warping stopped at its edge.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Gravity.
